answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 152491 Country: Qatar Title: Performing two sajdah after taravih and reading “سبوح، قدوس، رب الملائكة والروح” ten times with Ayatul Kursi Question: I would like to know that performing two sajdah after taravih in which we recite SUBBOOHUN, QUDDOOSUN RAABUL MALAIKATI WARROOH (total 10 times) with Ayatul Kursi is from which book this has been quoted. Also please clarify that is it sahih, dhaeef or fabricated. Answer ID: 152491 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1385/1376/L=12/1438) Performing two sajdah after taravih and reading “ سبوح، قدوس، رب الملائكة والروح ” ten times with Ayatul Kursi is not proved. It is bida’h to practice it during taravih salah, thus it must be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
